Select the first 200 metabolism records for CYP2D6. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate molregno, then join to compound_structures for canonical_smiles and molecule_dictionary for the substrate compound name. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to retrieve the parent compound name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not sort; preserve source row order.
